name: ai-coding-hub
description: Multi-provider AI coding & strategy hub - React client + Express/SQLite server

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
